title: alansmia concinna
intro: Alansmia concinna, commonly known as the "Mexican evergreen fern", is a type of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The health benefits of Alansmia concinna include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of soothing the respiratory tract and relieving coughs. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's chemical composition.
